attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Pharmacy (Division of Consumer Affairs)

rules.notes: Registration renews biennially with a renewal application and fee, without a CE requirement (N.J.A.C. 13:39-6.13); the Board's continuing education rules (N.J.A.C. 13:39 subchapter 3A) are for pharmacists. The Board does not require technicians to be nationally certified (Board FAQ). Chapter 39 was readopted effective March 11, 2024.
rules.rule_quote: The pharmacy technician shall submit a renewal application to the Board, along with the renewal fee set forth in N.J.A.C. 13:39-1.3, prior to the date of registration expiration.
